integrity: Universal claims have a complete Fourier-band and cycle proof; exact finite checks corroborate but do not replace it. Self-review only; no independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives noiseless complex-matrix measurement ranks and a phase-retrieval criterion for all single-nonzero-character deletions, not stability or optimal subfamily size. Prior cyclic phase-retrieval classification is credited. Bibliographic novelty has residual risk.
title: Exact matrix-recovery ranks for one-frequency deletion frames on finite abelian groups
